question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a purple present, Bob has a gold present, and Claire has a silver present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) purple present
(B) gold present
(C) silver present
solution:
Present colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (purple, gold, silver)
1. Alice ↔ Bob: (gold, purple, silver)
2. Bob ↔ Alice: (purple, gold, silver)
3. Alice ↔ Bob: (gold, purple, silver)
Claire has the silver present, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
